title: Not super impressed, but not horribly disappointed
text: Not super impressed, but not horribly disappointed. Not super impressed, but not horribly disappointed.  The instructions were in HORRIBLE English.  I couldn't understand them at all.  Once I found a tutorial on YouTube, though, they were easy to use and made a great pom pom.  I'm excited about the 4 different sizes, but I'm a little worried about the little white clips that hold the pieces together.  I don't think they will last very long.

product_metadata.title: Bluecell 8pcs 4 Sizes Easy Wrap Ball Weaver Pom Pon Maker Kit
